name: McKENZIE, Zoe Anne

headline.note: Legal practice, university research, commercial advisory work and a French research appointment are documented beyond the brief parliamentary biography. career_spells.employer: Kommerz Pty Ltd trading as Trade and Investment Advisory
career_spells.evidence_note: Own commercial advisory business documented in 2016–17, 2018 and 2021 biographies. Australian Business Register history resolves the exact legal entity: Kommerz Pty Ltd was active from 1 October 2016 to 6 January 2023 and held the Trade and Investment Advisory business name from 25 October 2016 to 12 March 2020. Registry dates concern the entity/name, not McKenzie's personal work; they are not adopted as employment boundaries. Contemporary reporting first published 15 December 2021 says she had stood down from her company to pursue preselection. This supports a December 2021 personal-work endpoint at month precision, not an exact day, FTE or hours. Overlapping boards are not additive.

research_notes: Follow-up: recover legal and KPMG employment dates/hours, advisory-business start/end and full-time evidence; establish seconding employer/payroll and overlap; date Melbourne research and ministerial roles. Resolve April/May 2021 committee discrepancy and any employment during breaks.

2026-09-29 initial pass compared APH, maiden speech, 2023 constitutional and workplace speeches, school Career Expo biography, 2014 French government report, NBN 2018/2022 and Australia Council 2016–17/2021–22 annual reports, Committee for Mornington Peninsula 2020–21 report and 2018 Finance announcement. All sources publicly accessible; no outreach.

Targeted searches for Corrs, Freehills, KPMG, full-time work, Trade and Investment Advisory founding and Fondation chronology did not supply employment hours or complete endpoints. Excluded unrelated US/Canadian namesakes and profile aggregators. Remaining leads include law-firm alumni archives, foundation annual staffing records and public professional CV.

Primary speech reveals a departmental secondment omitted from standard biography; do not count as public service without employer evidence or double-count underlying legal work. A 2003 promotion and 2004 policy return appear in secondary biography, not yet substantiated by inspected primary records.

French original describes chief adviser to Victorian Premier in 2011–2013 and former head of KPMG chairman's office. Research offer was for one year in 2008; hours and actual endpoint remain unknown. Broader council biography mentions French government advice but does not identify a separate appointment; retain that as a lead, not invented public employment.

Concurrent directorships, advisory committees and business operation remain separate. Board fees, principal and senior-associate titles cannot establish full-time duration. Unknown is not zero; record remains blocked despite substantial chronology recovery.

2026-10-02 follow-up located contemporary Fondapol author biography, separating dated Nelson/Bishop2003–2006 and Brandis2007 political roles and confirming senior research in2008. The2003/2004 start conflict is explicit; no full-time inference. Searches for KPMG tenure, law-firm promotion records and advisory-business founding produced no admissible hours/endpoints. An aggregation profile suggests July2016 business founding and November2013 Robb appointment, but is discovery-only and not entered as dates; seek primary business/ministerial records. Namesake professional profiles excluded. Next: KPMG chairman/CEO office archives, Freehills2003 promotions, and business registration corroborated with actual work rather than registration alone. Both totals remain null.

2026-10-03 follow-up: Australian Business Register history identifies Kommerz Pty Ltd as the exact legal entity behind Trade and Investment Advisory, materially resolving the advisory employer identity and private-company control. The entity was active 1 October 2016–6 January 2023 and the business name registered 25 October 2016–12 March 2020. Those are entity/name dates, not McKenzie's work dates: official biographies observe her leading the firm from 2016–17 onward, and contemporary 15 December 2021 reporting says she had stood down from her company to seek preselection. No exact personal start/end, hours or full-time status is inferred. Parliamentary committee material also describes the earlier KPMG function as strategic advice to a major professional-services CEO, consistent with but not dating the French biography's named KPMG chairman-office role. Legal-practice, KPMG, secondment payroll and personal advisory-work boundaries remain unresolved.

2026-10-04 follow-up: Mornington Peninsula News reporting first published 15 December 2021 says McKenzie had stood down from her own Trade & Investment Advisory company and several boards to pursue preselection. The advisory-business spell now ends at December 2021 month precision; the publication date is not used as the exact cessation day and does not prove hours. Exact commencement, KPMG and legal-practice dates, and secondment payroll remain unresolved. Targeted firm/alumni searches returned only derivative 2003 Freehills and 2004 policy claims, so those were not promoted over the conflicting contemporary employer biography.
